verses.original: וַֽיהוָ֛ה פָּקַ֥ד אֶת־ שָׂרָ֖ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמָ֑ר וַיַּ֧עַשׂ יְהוָ֛ה לְשָׂרָ֖ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֵּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh pā·qaḏ ’eṯ- śā·rāh ka·’ă·šer ’ā·mār way·ya·‘aś Yah·weh lə·śā·rāh ka·’ă·šer dib·bêr
verses.literal: Now the LORD attended to Sarah as He had said and the LORD did for Sarah what He had promised

verses.original: וַתַּהַר֩ וַתֵּ֨לֶד שָׂרָ֧ה לְאַבְרָהָ֛ם בֵּ֖ן לִזְקֻנָ֑יו לַמּוֹעֵ֕ד אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבֶּ֥ר אֹת֖וֹ אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wat·ta·har wat·tê·leḏ śā·rāh lə·’aḇ·rā·hām bên liz·qu·nāw lam·mō·w·‘êḏ ’ă·šer- dib·ber ’ō·ṯōw ’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: So Sarah conceived and bore a son to Abraham in his old age at the very time God had promised . . .

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֨א אַבְרָהָ֜ם אֶֽת־ שֶׁם־ בְּנ֧וֹ הַנּֽוֹלַד־ ל֛וֹ אֲשֶׁר־ יָלְדָה־ לּ֥וֹ שָׂרָ֖ה יִצְחָֽק׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā ’aḇ·rā·hām ’eṯ- šem- bə·nōw han·nō·w·laḏ- lōw ’ă·šer- yā·lə·ḏāh- lōw śā·rāh yiṣ·ḥāq
verses.literal: And Abraham gave the name Isaac to the son - Sarah bore to him

verses.original: וַיָּ֤מָל אַבְרָהָם֙ אֶת־ יִצְחָ֣ק בְּנ֔וֹ בֶּן־ שְׁמֹנַ֖ת יָמִ֑ים כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה אֹת֖וֹ אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·māl ’aḇ·rā·hām ’eṯ- yiṣ·ḥāq bə·nōw ben- šə·mō·naṯ yā·mîm ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh ’ō·ṯōw ’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: When his son . . . Isaac was eight days old Abraham circumcised him as God had commanded him

verses.original: וְאַבְרָהָ֖ם בֶּן־ מְאַ֣ת שָׁנָ֑ה בְּהִוָּ֣לֶד ל֔וֹ אֵ֖ת יִצְחָ֥ק בְּנֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’aḇ·rā·hām ben- mə·’aṯ šā·nāh bə·hiw·wā·leḏ lōw ’êṯ yiṣ·ḥāq bə·nōw
verses.literal: Abraham was a hundred years old . . . when his son Isaac was born to him

verses.original: וַתֹּ֣אמֶר שָׂרָ֔ה צְחֹ֕ק עָ֥שָׂה לִ֖י אֱלֹהִ֑ים כָּל־ הַשֹּׁמֵ֖עַ יִֽצְחַק־ לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer śā·rāh ṣə·ḥōq ‘ā·śāh lî ’ĕ·lō·hîm kāl- haš·šō·mê·a‘ yiṣ·ḥaq- lî
verses.literal: Then Sarah said God has made me laugh and everyone who hears of this will laugh with me

verses.original: וַתֹּ֗אמֶר מִ֤י מִלֵּל֙ לְאַבְרָהָ֔ם הֵינִ֥יקָה בָנִ֖ים שָׂרָ֑ה כִּֽי־ יָלַ֥דְתִּי בֵ֖ן לִזְקֻנָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer mî mil·lêl lə·’aḇ·rā·hām hê·nî·qāh ḇā·nîm śā·rāh kî- yā·laḏ·tî ḇên liz·qu·nāw
verses.literal: She added Who would have told Abraham that Sarah would nurse children Yet I have borne him a son in his old age

verses.original: וַיִּגְדַּ֥ל הַיֶּ֖לֶד וַיִּגָּמַ֑ל וַיַּ֤עַשׂ אַבְרָהָם֙ מִשְׁתֶּ֣ה גָד֔וֹל בְּי֖וֹם הִגָּמֵ֥ל אֶת־ יִצְחָֽק׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiḡ·dal hay·ye·leḏ way·yig·gā·mal way·ya·‘aś ’aḇ·rā·hām miš·teh ḡā·ḏō·wl bə·yō·wm hig·gā·mêl ’eṯ- yiṣ·ḥāq
verses.literal: So the child grew and was weaned and Abraham held a great feast on the day Isaac was weaned

verses.original: וַתֵּ֨רֶא שָׂרָ֜ה אֶֽת־ בֶּן־ הָגָ֧ר הַמִּצְרִ֛ית אֲשֶׁר־ יָלְדָ֥ה לְאַבְרָהָ֖ם מְצַחֵֽק׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tê·re śā·rāh ’eṯ- ben- hā·ḡār ham·miṣ·rîṯ ’ă·šer- yā·lə·ḏāh lə·’aḇ·rā·hām mə·ṣa·ḥêq
verses.literal: But Sarah saw that the son whom Hagar the Egyptian had borne to Abraham was mocking her son

verses.original: וַתֹּ֙אמֶר֙ לְאַבְרָהָ֔ם גָּרֵ֛שׁ הָאָמָ֥ה הַזֹּ֖את וְאֶת־ בְּנָ֑הּ כִּ֣י לֹ֤א יִירַשׁ֙ בֶּן־ הָאָמָ֣ה הַזֹּ֔את עִם־ בְּנִ֖י עִם־ יִצְחָֽק׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer lə·’aḇ·rā·hām gā·rêš hā·’ā·māh haz·zōṯ wə·’eṯ- bə·nāh kî lō yî·raš ben- hā·’ā·māh haz·zōṯ ‘im- bə·nî ‘im- yiṣ·ḥāq
verses.literal: and she said to Abraham Expel the slave woman and her son for the slave woman’s . . . son will never share in the inheritance with my son . . . Isaac

verses.original: וַיֵּ֧רַע הַדָּבָ֛ר מְאֹ֖ד בְּעֵינֵ֣י אַבְרָהָ֑ם עַ֖ל אוֹדֹ֥ת בְּנֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ra‘ had·dā·ḇār mə·’ōḏ bə·‘ê·nê ’aḇ·rā·hām ‘al ’ō·w·ḏōṯ bə·nōw
verses.literal: Now this matter distressed . . . Abraham greatly because it concerned his son Ishmael

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֜ים אֶל־ אַבְרָהָ֗ם אַל־ יֵרַ֤ע בְּעֵינֶ֙יךָ֙ עַל־ הַנַּ֣עַר וְעַל־ אֲמָתֶ֔ךָ כֹּל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר תֹּאמַ֥ר אֵלֶ֛יךָ שָׂרָ֖ה שְׁמַ֣ע בְּקֹלָ֑הּ כִּ֣י בְיִצְחָ֔ק יִקָּרֵ֥א לְךָ֖ זָֽרַע׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’el- ’aḇ·rā·hām ’al- yê·ra‘ bə·‘ê·ne·ḵā ‘al- han·na·‘ar wə·‘al- ’ă·mā·ṯe·ḵā kōl ’ă·šer tō·mar ’ê·le·ḵā śā·rāh šə·ma‘ bə·qō·lāh kî ḇə·yiṣ·ḥāq yiq·qā·rê lə·ḵā zā·ra‘
verses.literal: But God said to Abraham Do not be distressed . . . about the boy . . . and your maidservant Listen to . . . everything that Sarah tells you for through Isaac your offspring will be reckoned

verses.original: וְגַ֥ם אֶת־ בֶּן־ הָאָמָ֖ה לְג֣וֹי אֲשִׂימֶ֑נּוּ כִּ֥י זַרְעֲךָ֖ הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam ’eṯ- ben- hā·’ā·māh lə·ḡō·w ’ă·śî·men·nū kî zar·‘ă·ḵā hū
verses.literal: But I will also make a nation of the slave woman’s son because he is your offspring

verses.original: וַיַּשְׁכֵּ֣ם אַבְרָהָ֣ם׀ בַּבֹּ֡קֶר וַיִּֽקַּֽח־ לֶחֶם֩ וְחֵ֨מַת מַ֜יִם וַיִּתֵּ֣ן אֶל־ הָ֠גָר שָׂ֧ם עַל־ שִׁכְמָ֛הּ וְאֶת־ הַיֶּ֖לֶד וַֽיְשַׁלְּחֶ֑הָ וַתֵּ֣לֶךְ וַתֵּ֔תַע בְּמִדְבַּ֖ר בְּאֵ֥ר שָֽׁבַע׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaš·kêm ’aḇ·rā·hām bab·bō·qer way·yiq·qaḥ- le·ḥem wə·ḥê·maṯ ma·yim way·yit·tên ’el- hā·ḡār śām ‘al- šiḵ·māh wə·’eṯ- hay·ye·leḏ way·šal·lə·ḥe·hā wat·tê·leḵ wat·tê·ṯa‘ bə·miḏ·bar bə·’êr šā·ḇa‘
verses.literal: Early in the morning Abraham got up took bread and a skin of water . . . . . . . . . put them on Hagar’s shoulders and sent her away with the boy . . . She left and wandered in the Wilderness of Beersheba

verses.original: וַיִּכְל֥וּ הַמַּ֖יִם מִן־ הַחֵ֑מֶת וַתַּשְׁלֵ֣ךְ אֶת־ הַיֶּ֔לֶד תַּ֖חַת אַחַ֥ד הַשִּׂיחִֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiḵ·lū ham·ma·yim min- ha·ḥê·meṯ wat·taš·lêḵ ’eṯ- hay·ye·leḏ ta·ḥaṯ ’a·ḥaḏ haś·śî·ḥim
verses.literal: When the water in the skin was gone she left the boy under one of the bushes

verses.original: וַתֵּלֶךְ֩ וַתֵּ֨שֶׁב לָ֜הּ מִנֶּ֗גֶד הַרְחֵק֙ כִּמְטַחֲוֵ֣י קֶ֔שֶׁת כִּ֣י אָֽמְרָ֔ה אַל־ אֶרְאֶ֖ה בְּמ֣וֹת הַיָּ֑לֶד וַתֵּ֣שֶׁב מִנֶּ֔גֶד וַתִּשָּׂ֥א אֶת־ קֹלָ֖הּ וַתֵּֽבְךְּ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tê·leḵ wat·tê·šeḇ lāh min·ne·ḡeḏ har·ḥêq kim·ṭa·ḥă·wê qe·šeṯ kî ’ā·mə·rāh ’al- ’er·’eh bə·mō·wṯ hay·yā·leḏ wat·tê·šeḇ min·ne·ḡeḏ wat·tiś·śā ’eṯ- qō·lāh wat·tê·ḇək
verses.literal: Then she went off and sat down nearby about a bowshot . . . away for she said I cannot bear to watch the boy die And as she sat nearby she lifted up her voice and wept

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֣ע אֱלֹהִים֮ אֶת־ ק֣וֹל הַנַּעַר֒ וַיִּקְרָא֩ מַלְאַ֨ךְ אֱלֹהִ֤ים׀ אֶל־ הָגָר֙ מִן־ הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וַיֹּ֥אמֶר לָ֖הּ מַה־ לָּ֣ךְ הָגָ֑ר אַל־ תִּ֣ירְאִ֔י כִּֽי־ שָׁמַ֧ע אֱלֹהִ֛ים אֶל־ ק֥וֹל הַנַּ֖עַר בַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר הוּא־ שָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·ma‘ ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’eṯ- qō·wl han·na·‘ar way·yiq·rā mal·’aḵ ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’el- hā·ḡār min- haš·šā·ma·yim way·yō·mer lāh mah- lāḵ hā·ḡār ’al- tî·rə·’î kî- šā·ma‘ ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’el- qō·wl han·na·‘ar ba·’ă·šer hū- šām
verses.literal: Then God heard the voice of the boy and the angel of God called to Hagar from heaven What is wrong Hagar Do not be afraid for God . . . has heard the voice of the boy where he lies

verses.original: ק֚וּמִי שְׂאִ֣י אֶת־ הַנַּ֔עַר וְהַחֲזִ֥יקִי אֶת־ יָדֵ֖ךְ בּ֑וֹ כִּֽי־ לְג֥וֹי גָּד֖וֹל אֲשִׂימֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: qū·mî śə·’î ’eṯ- han·na·‘ar wə·ha·ḥă·zî·qî ’eṯ- yā·ḏêḵ bōw kî- lə·ḡō·w gā·ḏō·wl ’ă·śî·men·nū
verses.literal: Get up lift up the boy and take him by the hand for I will make him into a great nation

verses.original: וַיִּפְקַ֤ח אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת־ עֵינֶ֔יהָ וַתֵּ֖רֶא בְּאֵ֣ר מָ֑יִם וַתֵּ֜לֶךְ וַתְּמַלֵּ֤א אֶת־ הַחֵ֙מֶת֙ מַ֔יִם וַתַּ֖שְׁקְ אֶת־ הַנָּֽעַר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yip̄·qaḥ ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’eṯ- ‘ê·ne·hā wat·tê·re bə·’êr mā·yim wat·tê·leḵ wat·tə·mal·lê ’eṯ- ha·ḥê·meṯ ma·yim wat·tašq ’eṯ- han·nā·‘ar
verses.literal: Then God opened her eyes and she saw a well of water So she went and filled the skin with water . . . and gave the boy a drink

verses.original: וַיְהִ֧י אֱלֹהִ֛ים אֶת־ הַנַּ֖עַר וַיִּגְדָּ֑ל וַיֵּ֙שֶׁב֙ בַּמִּדְבָּ֔ר וַיְהִ֖י רֹבֶ֥ה קַשָּֽׁת׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’eṯ- han·na·‘ar way·yiḡ·dāl way·yê·šeḇ bam·miḏ·bār way·hî rō·ḇeh qaš·šāṯ
verses.literal: And God was with the boy and he grew up and settled in the wilderness and became a great archer

verses.original: וַיֵּ֖שֶׁב בְּמִדְבַּ֣ר פָּארָ֑ן וַתִּֽקַּֽח־ ל֥וֹ אִמּ֛וֹ אִשָּׁ֖ה מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yê·šeḇ bə·miḏ·bar pā·rān wat·tiq·qaḥ- lōw ’im·mōw ’iš·šāh mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: And while he was dwelling in the Wilderness of Paran his mother got a wife for him from the land of Egypt

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֔וא וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲבִימֶ֗לֶךְ וּפִיכֹל֙ שַׂר־ צְבָא֔וֹ אֶל־ אַבְרָהָ֖ם לֵאמֹ֑ר אֱלֹהִ֣ים עִמְּךָ֔ בְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ אַתָּ֖ה עֹשֶֽׂה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî bā·‘êṯ ha·hi·w way·yō·mer ’ă·ḇî·me·leḵ ū·p̄î·ḵōl śar- ṣə·ḇā·’ōw ’el- ’aḇ·rā·hām lê·mōr ’ĕ·lō·hîm ‘im·mə·ḵā bə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- ’at·tāh ‘ō·śeh
verses.literal: At that time Abimelech and Phicol the commander of his army said to Abraham . . . God is with you in all that you do

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה הִשָּׁ֨בְעָה לִּ֤י בֵֽאלֹהִים֙ הֵ֔נָּה אִם־ תִּשְׁקֹ֣ר לִ֔י וּלְנִינִ֖י וּלְנֶכְדִּ֑י כַּחֶ֜סֶד אֲשֶׁר־ עָשִׂ֤יתִי עִמְּךָ֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה עִמָּדִ֔י וְעִם־ הָאָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ גַּ֥רְתָּה בָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh hiš·šā·ḇə·‘āh lî ḇê·lō·hîm hên·nāh ’im- tiš·qōr lî ū·lə·nî·nî ū·lə·neḵ·dî ka·ḥe·seḏ ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śî·ṯî ‘im·mə·ḵā ta·‘ă·śeh ‘im·mā·ḏî wə·‘im- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer- gar·tāh bāh
verses.literal: Now, therefore swear to me here before God that you will not deal falsely with me or my children or descendants Show to me and to the country in which you reside . . . the same kindness that I have shown to you

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אַבְרָהָ֔ם אָנֹכִ֖י אִשָּׁבֵֽעַ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’aḇ·rā·hām ’ā·nō·ḵî ’iš·šā·ḇê·a‘
verses.literal: And Abraham replied I swear it.

verses.original: וְהוֹכִ֥חַ אַבְרָהָ֖ם אֶת־ אֲבִימֶ֑לֶךְ עַל־ אֹדוֹת֙ בְּאֵ֣ר הַמַּ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֥ר גָּזְל֖וּ עַבְדֵ֥י אֲבִימֶֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hō·w·ḵi·aḥ ’aḇ·rā·hām ’eṯ- ’ă·ḇî·me·leḵ ‘al- ’ō·ḏō·wṯ bə·’êr ham·ma·yim ’ă·šer gā·zə·lū ‘aḇ·ḏê ’ă·ḇî·me·leḵ
verses.literal: But when Abraham complained to Abimelech about . . . a well . . . that Abimelech’s servants had seized

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲבִימֶ֔לֶךְ לֹ֣א יָדַ֔עְתִּי מִ֥י עָשָׂ֖ה אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֑ה וְגַם־ אַתָּ֞ה לֹא־ הִגַּ֣דְתָּ לִּ֗י וְגַ֧ם אָנֹכִ֛י לֹ֥א שָׁמַ֖עְתִּי בִּלְתִּ֥י הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ă·ḇî·me·leḵ lō yā·ḏa‘·tî mî ‘ā·śāh ’eṯ- had·dā·ḇār haz·zeh wə·ḡam- ’at·tāh lō- hig·gaḏ·tā lî wə·ḡam ’ā·nō·ḵî lō šā·ma‘·tî bil·tî hay·yō·wm
verses.literal: Abimelech replied I do not know who has done this . . . . . . You did not tell me . . . so I have not heard about it until today . . .

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֤ח אַבְרָהָם֙ צֹ֣אן וּבָקָ֔ר וַיִּתֵּ֖ן לַאֲבִימֶ֑לֶךְ וַיִּכְרְת֥וּ שְׁנֵיהֶ֖ם בְּרִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ ’aḇ·rā·hām ṣōn ū·ḇā·qār way·yit·tên la·’ă·ḇî·me·leḵ way·yiḵ·rə·ṯū šə·nê·hem bə·rîṯ
verses.literal: So Abraham brought sheep and cattle and gave them to Abimelech and the two men made a covenant

verses.original: וַיַּצֵּ֣ב אַבְרָהָ֗ם אֶת־ שֶׁ֛בַע כִּבְשֹׂ֥ת הַצֹּ֖אן לְבַדְּהֶֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaṣ·ṣêḇ ’aḇ·rā·hām ’eṯ- še·ḇa‘ kiḇ·śōṯ haṣ·ṣōn lə·ḇad·də·hen
verses.literal: Abraham separated . . . seven ewe lambs from the flock

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֲבִימֶ֖לֶךְ אֶל־ אַבְרָהָ֑ם מָ֣ה הֵ֗נָּה שֶׁ֤בַע כְּבָשֹׂת֙ הָאֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִצַּ֖בְתָּ לְבַדָּֽנָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ă·ḇî·me·leḵ ’el- ’aḇ·rā·hām māh hên·nāh še·ḇa‘ kə·ḇā·śōṯ hā·’êl·leh ’ă·šer hiṣ·ṣaḇ·tā lə·ḇad·dā·nāh
verses.literal: and Abimelech asked . . . him Why . . . have you set apart . . . these seven ewe lambs

verses.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר כִּ֚י אֶת־ שֶׁ֣בַע כְּבָשֹׂ֔ת תִּקַּ֖ח מִיָּדִ֑י בַּעֲבוּר֙ תִּֽהְיֶה־ לִּ֣י לְעֵדָ֔ה כִּ֥י חָפַ֖רְתִּי אֶת־ הַבְּאֵ֥ר הַזֹּֽאת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer kî ’eṯ- še·ḇa‘ kə·ḇā·śōṯ tiq·qaḥ mî·yā·ḏî ba·‘ă·ḇūr tih·yeh- lî lə·‘ê·ḏāh kî ḥā·p̄ar·tî ’eṯ- hab·bə·’êr haz·zōṯ
verses.literal: He replied You are to accept the seven ewe lambs from my hand as my witness that I dug this well

verses.original: עַל־ כֵּ֗ן קָרָ֛א לַמָּק֥וֹם הַה֖וּא בְּאֵ֣ר שָׁ֑בַע כִּ֛י שָׁ֥ם נִשְׁבְּע֖וּ שְׁנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- kên qā·rā lam·mā·qō·wm ha·hū bə·’êr šā·ḇa‘ kî šām niš·bə·‘ū šə·nê·hem
verses.literal: So . . . that place was called Beersheba because it was there that the two of them swore an oath

verses.original: וַיִּכְרְת֥וּ בְרִ֖ית בִּבְאֵ֣ר שָׁ֑בַע וַיָּ֣קָם אֲבִימֶ֗לֶךְ וּפִיכֹל֙ שַׂר־ צְבָא֔וֹ וַיָּשֻׁ֖בוּ אֶל־ אֶ֥רֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiḵ·rə·ṯū ḇə·rîṯ biḇ·’êr šā·ḇa‘ way·yā·qām ’ă·ḇî·me·leḵ ū·p̄î·ḵōl śar- ṣə·ḇā·’ōw way·yā·šu·ḇū ’el- ’e·reṣ pə·liš·tîm
verses.literal: After they had made the covenant at Beersheba Abimelech and Phicol the commander of his army got up and returned to the land of the Philistines

verses.original: וַיִּטַּ֥ע אֶ֖שֶׁל בִּבְאֵ֣ר שָׁ֑בַע וַיִּ֨קְרָא־ שָׁ֔ם בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה אֵ֥ל עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiṭ·ṭa‘ ’e·šel biḇ·’êr šā·ḇa‘ way·yiq·rā- šām bə·šêm Yah·weh ’êl ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: And Abraham planted a tamarisk tree in Beersheba and there he called upon the name of the LORD the Eternal God

verses.original: וַיָּ֧גָר אַבְרָהָ֛ם בְּאֶ֥רֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים יָמִ֥ים רַבִּֽים׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḡār ’aḇ·rā·hām bə·’e·reṣ pə·liš·tîm yā·mîm rab·bîm
verses.literal: And Abraham resided in the land of the Philistines for a long time
